subjects.description: All vehicles present in the source video, traveling through the intersection
subjects.appearance_details: Re-rendered surfaces reflect artificial light sources and have a slightly wet or damp quality. Colors are desaturated relative to daytime appearance. Preserve every vehicle's original body shape, color, size, and visual identity from the source video.
subjects.relationship: Same relative positions, lane occupancy, and interactions between vehicles as the source video
subjects.pose: All vehicles remain upright with wheels naturally contacting the road surface
subjects.action: Identical actions and trajectories as the source video — only surface appearance changes, not behavior or motion
subjects.state_changes: Identical to the source video — traffic timing and event progression unchanged
subjects.number_of_subjects: Multiple vehicles, matching the source video count

background_setting: The same structural layout and scene geometry as the source video, re-rendered under nighttime conditions with artificial lighting. Surfaces appear wet from recent rainfall — reflective road surfaces with pooled light, damp curbs and structures. Streetlights and traffic signal heads become the primary light sources. Ambient sky glow provides soft fill from above. All scene geometry, camera angle, and composition are preserved exactly.

environmental_transformation.transformation_scope: Replace daytime or ambient lighting with nighttime artificial illumination and apply wet, reflective surface appearance to the roadway, sidewalks, and surrounding terrain. Change only the sky, exposure, ambient illumination, and surface appearance.
environmental_transformation.preservation_requirements: Preserve the exact source-video camera position, crop, perspective, field of view, intersection geometry, vehicle identities, vehicle count, trajectories, speeds, relative spacing, and event timing.
prohibited_changes: Do not move any vehicle into a different lane or alter its original trajectory
Do not add, remove, duplicate, replace, recolor, or resize any vehicle
Do not alter vehicle speeds, spacing, or traffic timing
Do not add active rainfall, fog, or snow — the pavement is wet but no precipitation is falling
Do not alter the intersection geometry, curbs, signal poles, or surrounding structures
Do not add pedestrians, new roadside structures, or emergency vehicles
Do not retain daytime lighting or an unclouded bright sky

lighting.conditions: Nighttime with mixed artificial point sources — significantly different from the source video; post-rain atmospheric quality
lighting.direction: Multiple point sources from above (streetlights, traffic signal heads); remaining ambient from overcast sky glow
lighting.shadows: High-contrast pools of warm artificial light against dark surroundings; deep shadows between light sources; secondary reflections from wet ground surfaces
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast scene with warm artificial pools against cool ambient darkness; wet surfaces create mirror-like secondary light reflections beneath every lit element
lighting.sky: Dark overcast night sky, no stars or moon visible, consistent with recent rainfall
lighting.surface_conditions: Wet, reflective road surface throughout the intersection with visible pooling near curbs; damp sidewalks and structures; no standing precipitation falling
lighting.artificial_lighting: Streetlights and traffic signal heads are active and are the primary light sources, their glow mirrored in the wet pavement

aesthetics.composition: Same fixed overhead intersection framing as the source video
aesthetics.color_scheme: Cool dark-blue night tones with warm amber reflections, desaturated wet asphalt, high-contrast light pools
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Moody, high-contrast nighttime post-rain traffic scene
aesthetics.patterns: Mirror-like reflections of lights on wet pavement, halos around light sources

cinematography.camera_motion: Identical to source video — locked off
cinematography.framing: Identical to source video — wide overhead intersection view
cinematography.camera_angle: Identical to source video — elevated fixed camera angle
cinematography.camera_preservation: Preserve the exact source camera. Do not pan, tilt, zoom, crop, reframe, rotate, or alter perspective.

control_guidance.structure_priority: Use the input-video edges as strict structural guidance. Preserve every vehicle silhouette, lane boundary, curb, crosswalk, and signal pole throughout the clip.
control_guidance.appearance_freedom: Allow changes only to sky appearance, illumination, surface wetness and reflectivity, shadow character, and color temperature
control_guidance.motion_priority: All vehicles must follow their exact source-video trajectories. Edge guidance must not cause vehicles to change lanes, stop unexpectedly, or disappear.
control_guidance.temporal_consistency: Maintain stable reflections, light placement, and vehicle appearance across every frame. Wet-surface reflections must not flicker or drift independently of the light sources.

artistic_style: Photorealistic nighttime traffic-surveillance footage under wet, post-rain conditions
context: Nighttime wet-pavement augmentation of an existing intersection traffic video using Cosmos 3 Transfer with Edge control
negative_prompt: daytime, bright sunlight, clear sky, dry pavement, active rainfall, snow, fog, corrected vehicle trajectory, changed lane position, changed traffic direction, changed speed, collision, added vehicle, removed vehicle, duplicated vehicle, recolored vehicle, added pedestrian, added building, camera motion, camera shake, pan, tilt, zoom, geometry drift, flicker
audio_description: Preserve the original video audio without alteration. Do not add rain sounds, thunder, sirens, horns, or new traffic audio.
